---
title: "MTB ICS cohort: acquisition drift and instrument shift"
output: html_document
params:
  out: "results"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
out <- params$out
rd <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(out, f))) read.csv(file.path(out, f), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else NULL
tt <- rd("tubes.csv"); dec <- rd("decisions.csv"); eff_files <- list.files(out, "^effects_.*csv$", full.names = TRUE)
eff <- do.call(rbind, lapply(eff_files, read.csv))
```

Plan: `docs/plans/mtb_batch_drift_plan.md`. The file-name field `batch` is prior vaccination status and is a protected covariate throughout.

## Design

```{r}
knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(tt$acq_day, tt$instrument)), caption = "Tubes per acquisition day and instrument")
knitr::kable(rd("bridge_report.csv"), caption = "Patients bridging days and instruments")
```

## Decisions

```{r}
knitr::kable(dec[dec$term == "instrument", ], digits = 3, caption = "Instrument contrast, every response")
knitr::kable(dec[dec$term == "day" & grepl("^detected", dec$verdict), ], digits = 3, caption = "Acquisition days with an effect above replicate noise")
```

## Day effects, all fitters

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(eff) && nrow(eff)) {
  s <- aggregate(value ~ model + layer + response + term + level, eff, function(x) c(m = mean(x), lo = quantile(x, .025), hi = quantile(x, .975)))
  s <- do.call(data.frame, s)
  d <- s[s$term == "day" & s$layer == "A" & grepl(":median$", s$response), ]
  if (nrow(d)) print(ggplot(d, aes(level, value.m, colour = model)) + geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = value.lo, ymax = value.hi), position = position_dodge(.5)) +
    facet_wrap(~response, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = .5)) + labs(x = "acquisition day", y = "effect on neg-tube median (arcsinh units)"))
}
```

## Neg-tube distributions: EMD to reference

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
e <- rd("neg_emd.csv")
if (!is.null(e)) { e <- merge(e, tt, by = "filename"); print(ggplot(e, aes(acq_day, emd, colour = instrument)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~marker, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = .5))) }
```

## Gate-position drift (were shifts hand-corrected by the analyst?)

```{r}
g <- rd("gate_drift.csv"); if (!is.null(g)) knitr::kable(g, digits = 3) else cat("gate_bounds.csv empty: no rectangle/polygon gates found for the parent populations")
```

## Frequentist cross-check

```{r}
knitr::kable(rd("lme4_variance_components.csv"), digits = 4)
```

## Fitter agreement and BayesFlow acceptance

```{r}
fa <- rd("fitter_agreement.csv"); if (!is.null(fa)) knitr::kable(aggregate(agree ~ model_b + layer + term, fa, function(x) sprintf("%d/%d", sum(x), length(x))))
for (v in c("v1", "v2")) { r <- rd(sprintf("bf_%s_recovery.csv", v)); if (!is.null(r)) print(knitr::kable(merge(r, rd(sprintf("bf_%s_sbc.csv", v))), digits = 3, caption = paste("BayesFlow", v))) }
p <- rd("bf_v2_ppc.csv"); if (!is.null(p)) cat(sprintf("BayesFlow v2 posterior predictive: %.2f of real neg medians inside the 90%% band\n", mean(tolower(p$inside_90) == "true")))
tm <- list.files(out, "bf_v._timing.json", full.names = TRUE); for (f in tm) cat(basename(f), ":", readLines(f), "\n")
```
